description: This file contains implementation of MSI-X and MSI configuration and generation functions for a PCIe endpoint driver specific to Broadcom hardware, including interrupt handling and register access.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_msix_config
methods.description: Configures MSI-X capability with 16 messages, setting table and PBA offsets.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_generate_msi
methods.description: Generates an MSI interrupt for the specified MSI number.

methods.name: generate_msix
methods.description: Generates an MSI-X interrupt for the specified MSI-X number.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_func_mask_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for function mask interrupt, triggers pending MSI-X generation.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_vector_mask_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for vector mask interrupt, triggers generation of all pending MSI-X.

methods.name: iproc_pcie_generate_msix
methods.description: Public function to generate MSI-X interrupt for a given MSI-X number, with support for masking.
